observations: body L1: the title, in large capitals; the face is not imitated and the line is scaled to the box of the printed line. The note mark «(1)» is printed in a small type and slightly raised (its foot 1.3 pt above the baseline); it is set on the baseline. The rule under the title is 115.1 pt long and 0.72 pt thick. The running head of the page is its number XVI alone, over a rule across the measure.

body L2-L33: each addendum hangs from its reference at the margin: the page of the first volume (roman numerals of its preface, in small capitals), with the line or the note. The references are to Part I, pp. xi-xxxvi.
body L3: a speck between «l.» and «xiii» is not transcribed.

body L6, L8-L9, L10, L12, L15-L19, L23-L25, L28, L30-L31, L33: «Björnbo», «Hermannus Dalmata», «Secundus», «Fr. Boll», «Shādhān», «Rieu», «Abū Ma‘shar», «Baḥr», «Ibn Khaldūn», «Suter», «Bethen», «Bereni», «Apollonium Thyaneum», «al-Bīrūnī», «Sachau», «Phil. Angelitti», «Georgii Purbachii» and «Purbachius» are letter-spaced.

body L13-L15: the Arabic words of the London codex as read in Rieu's catalogue, set right to left inside the Latin lines as printed: «ابـــو معشر البلخي» ends L13; L14 begins with the rest of the title, «من المدخل الكبير [و]من مذاكرته مع سادار مي بحر», followed by its comma, and ends with «شادين بـــن», whose last word «نجران» begins L15; «شاذان بن بحر» stands before «; ergo». The و between square brackets is Nallino's addition. The elongated joins of «ابـــو» and «بـــن» are transcribed with tatweels.
body L16: «al–Balkhī» is printed with a long dash (5.5 pt), as transcribed; each line of the Latin rendering of the title (L15-L17) is opened by a guillemet.
body L17: «faṣl» is in roman type with the dot under the s; «III» and «LIV» are full capitals.
body L22: the ǵ of «ad-darīǵan» and «ad-darīǵān» has the acute above, the tail of the italic g printing detached below; the d of the second «ad-» prints broken.
body L26: the hyphens of «al-Ma’mūn ibn al-Ma’mūn» are short (2.0 pt).

body L18: «xxx, lin. 8–10»: the passage on Bethem, Bethen, Bereni and Apollonius of Tyana stands on Part I, p. XXXI, lines 8-10 (AB01-PDF0040-body-L008 to L010), the page of the next entry; p. XXX has nothing on it. Kept as printed.

notes_left L1-L7, notes_right L1-L7: two notes in two columns, with a thin rule between them; note 2 runs from the left column into the right. «nouarum» is printed with u. «Georgii Purbachij», «Georgii Purbachii» (divided «Purba-», «chii») are letter-spaced; the hyphens of «53,r.-61,v.», «259,v.-268,r.» and «390-411» measure 3.1-3.5 pt.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
